acceptanceCriteria: The spec's usefulness definition states whether and when PRESERVES counts, with the reason.
A fixture with a no-op diff does not score as useful under the amended definition.
body: Found in the V1-1677 spike (2026-10-18, docs/build-log/2026-10-18-cce-spike-v1-1677.md), falsifier F2: base already books, head adds only an HTML comment, prove reads PRESERVES (proof digest sha256:5647a0922138821e3dc06eb6f71c83332927fdf57b89408c19a74ed1737bfa68). The spec's job 5 usefulness definition counts PRESERVES with oracle_origin ADMITTED_AT_BASE as useful, so a no-op change scores as useful and inflates the 40% kill threshold. Question for the spec owner: should a PRESERVES verdict count only when the diff reaches the outcome's own render path, or not at all? F1 (static overlay reads DISCRIMINATES) is already addressed by the omitted-event controls in V1-1679.

title: CCE job 5 usefulness counts a PRESERVES verdict on an unchanged outcome as useful
